name: Deepwater Horizon
summary: Explosion and sinking of a drilling rig after a well blowout; oil flowed for about 87 days. Largest marine spill in history by most estimates.

name: Exxon Valdez
summary: Tanker ran aground on Bligh Reef; one of the most studied spills, with long-lasting damage to Alaska's coastline and fisheries.

name: Gulf War oil spill
summary: Oil deliberately released into the Persian Gulf during the Gulf War; estimates vary widely between roughly 4 and 11 million barrels.

name: Ixtoc I
summary: Exploratory well blowout that flowed for nearly ten months before being capped.

name: Atlantic Empress
summary: Two tankers collided during a tropical storm; Atlantic Empress burned and later sank in the largest ship-sourced spill on record.

name: Amoco Cadiz
summary: Supertanker lost steering and ran aground off Brittany, breaking up and spilling its entire cargo.

name: Torrey Canyon
summary: Supertanker struck Seven Stones reef; an early major tanker spill that prompted modern maritime pollution conventions.

name: Prestige
summary: Single-hulled tanker developed a hull crack in a storm and sank after being refused port; oil reached the Spanish and French coasts.

name: Erika
summary: Tanker broke in two in a storm, polluting the French Atlantic coast with heavy fuel oil.

name: Sea Empress
summary: Tanker grounded at the entrance to Milford Haven beside a national park coastline; one of the UK's worst spills.

name: Braer
summary: Tanker lost engine power and grounded in a storm; light crude was largely dispersed by heavy seas.

name: Ekofisk Bravo blowout
summary: Blowout during a workover at a North Sea platform; oil flowed for about a week before being capped.

name: Santa Barbara oil spill
summary: Offshore platform blowout that fouled Southern California beaches and helped spark the modern US environmental movement.

name: Lakeview Gusher
summary: Gusher that flowed for about 18 months; the largest accidental onshore spill on record, much of it held in earthen sumps.

name: Kalamazoo River spill (Line 6B)
summary: Pipeline rupture released heavy crude into Talmadge Creek and the Kalamazoo River; cleanup took years.

name: Mayflower pipeline spill
summary: Pipeline seam failure sent crude through a residential subdivision.

name: Tioga pipeline spill
summary: Pipeline leak contaminated farmland and went undetected by the operator's monitoring until a farmer found it.

name: Refugio Beach spill (Line 901)
summary: Corroded pipeline ruptured near the coast and oil reached the Pacific through a culvert.

name: Keystone pipeline Kansas spill
summary: Pipeline failure released crude into Mill Creek and surrounding land; one of the larger onshore crude spills in recent US history.

name: Taylor Energy platform leak
summary: Wells damaged by a Hurricane Ivan mudslide have leaked continuously since 2004; one of the longest-running offshore leaks.

name: Red Hill fuel leak
summary: Fuel leaks from a Navy bulk storage facility contaminated the drinking-water system serving military housing.

name: Lac-Megantic rail disaster
summary: Runaway crude oil train derailed and exploded in the town centre.

name: Rainbow Pipeline spill
summary: Pipeline rupture in a remote area of northern Alberta.

name: Husky Saskatchewan River spill
summary: Pipeline rupture from ground movement; downstream towns had to find alternate water supplies.

name: Guanabara Bay oil spill
summary: Refinery pipeline rupture spilled into Guanabara Bay, affecting mangroves and fishing communities.

name: 2019 Brazil coast oil spill
summary: Crude oil of unclear origin washed up on hundreds of beaches in northeastern Brazil; the source was never conclusively established.

name: Ventanilla oil spill
summary: Tanker unloading at a refinery spilled crude when abnormal waves from the Tonga volcanic eruption reached the coast; protected areas were affected.

name: Coca River pipeline rupture
summary: Pipelines ruptured after riverbank erosion; oil entered the Coca River and affected downstream communities.

name: Bodo spills (Ogoniland)
summary: Pipeline spills in Ogoniland mangrove creeks led to a long dispute and litigation, with a 2015 settlement for affected communities.

name: Bonga FPSO spill
summary: Release during offloading from a floating production vessel off Nigeria.

name: Wakashio oil spill
summary: Bulk carrier ran aground on a coral reef beside protected lagoons and later broke apart.

name: Rena oil spill
summary: Container ship grounded on a reef; widely described as New Zealand's worst maritime environmental disaster.

name: Hebei Spirit oil spill
summary: Tanker struck by a drifting crane barge; the largest spill in South Korean history.

name: Sanchi collision
summary: Iranian tanker collided with a freighter and burned for about a week before sinking; all crew were lost.

name: Chennai Ennore oil spill
summary: Two vessels collided near Ennore Port; oil spread along Chennai beaches.

name: MSC Chitra collision
summary: Container ship collided with another vessel at the entrance to Mumbai harbour, spilling fuel oil.

name: Baghjan oil well blowout
summary: Gas and oil well blowout in Assam followed by a fire; located near ecologically sensitive wetlands.

name: Jiyeh power station spill
summary: Fuel oil storage tanks hit in air strikes during the 2006 war; oil spread along the Lebanese coast.

name: Norilsk diesel spill
summary: Fuel tank at a power plant collapsed, discharging diesel onto land and into Arctic rivers; permafrost thaw was implicated.

name: Tlahuelilpan pipeline explosion
summary: Fuel pipeline illegally tapped by thieves; the leak ignited in a mass explosion that killed 137 people.

name: Bemidji crude oil spill
summary: Pipeline rupture at a site that became a long-term USGS research location on crude oil in groundwater.

name: Montara oil spill
summary: Wellhead platform blowout in the Timor Sea; the leak continued for about ten weeks until a relief well stopped it.
